decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation draws directly on the firm's control software and energy-recovery know-how, and its own R&D and university cooperation let it learn from early installations and refine the product.

The fouling detection system overlaps with Product A, but it supports the heat-recovery strategy, and the firm's research capacity lets it assimilate field results, so consolidation rather than withdrawal is more likely within a year.
The spring-controlled flap weir sits squarely in the firm's core hydraulic steel-structure expertise, where its project know-how lets it interpret and act on early results with confidence.
The energy management system builds on the firm's automation and IT modules and directly serves its digital-networking and efficiency strategy, so it fits the knowledge the firm already holds.
The overflow flap gate line is close to the core offer, has several models and its own web page, and draws fully on the firm's accumulated engineering experience.
